links.outcome: Radiologist plaque-detection sensitivity with versus without AI assistance in simulated clinical scenarios
links.effect: The model improved radiologists' sensitivity in diagnosing plaques in the Model-human study. Overreliance was not reported as assessed, and no numbers are given in the abstract.
links.quote: Furthermore, in Model-human Real Clinical Scenarios study, we found that the model improved the radiologists' sensitivity in diagnosing plaques.

links.outcome: Model diagnostic performance compared against 6 radiologists on the same plaque cases
links.effect: Model diagnostic results were higher than those of 4 out of 6 radiologists (p < 0.001). Model diagnostic time was 6 s, significantly shorter than that of all radiologists (p < 0.001).
links.quote: Especially, in the clinical application scenario analysis, the model's diagnostic results for plaques were found to be higher than those of 4 out of 6 radiologists (p < 0.001).

screen.reason: The study tests an AI model for carotid plaque detection and includes a model-human reader study comparing radiologist diagnostic performance and time with and without AI assistance.
